notes: Customer profile: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics). Heavy focus on in-app chat for support + contextual doc search inside product.
Primary KPI: reduce support MTTR and deflect tickets. Target p99 latency for chat < 150ms and average session token cost < $0.10.
Throughput target: sustained 150-250 qps during peak for embeddings/reranking pipelines; spikes to 400 qps for short bursts.
Cost sensitivity: high. Finance wants demonstrable unit economics before committing to Dedicated. ARR ask = $50k-$200k range depending on uplift.
Model preferences: leaning to open models (Llama-family) for cost control but open to Redwood-curated variants with quantization. Interested in quantized int8/int4 paths.
Routing/fallback: want hosted first, failover to dedicated regionally; prefer policy-based routing by latency then cost.
Optimization asks for workshop: batching guidance for chat (session-level batching), KV/prefix caching for common prompt prefixes, quantization profiles recommendation per workload.
POC notes: sample traffic shows many short sessions with repeated boilerplate — big opportunity for prefix caching. SE suggested 2x batching factor on encoder side to cut cost by ~30% in simulations.
Quote from CTO: "We cannot leak PII — any telemetry or logs sent off-platform must be encrypted and auditable."
Quote from Head of Product: "If you can show 3-4x improvement in token unit economics via batching+cache+quant, we can move to Dedicated."
Workshop goals: produce a prior/after unit economics sheet, recommended quantization profile per model, expected latency impact, and a sample rollout plan (canary + fallback).
Legal/security blockers: need explicit data residency statement for EU customers and confirmation of KMS support for hosted keys (or a private deployment option).
SE notes: plan A = 10-day Hosted optimization + instrumented cost telemetry; plan B = 2-week Dedicated canary if Hosted optimizations insufficient.
